lines.text: Tag Tracker opens with the rules: three point five meters, ambiguity zero point three, a quarter second, twenty five centimeters, three to restart, three to lock.
Lines forty seven to fifty three hold the sigma formula's numbers and the drift: two millimeters and a tenth of a degree.
Lines sixty two to sixty six are its memory: the tag pose, three variances, good photos, and jumps in a row.
Reset, lines eighty five to ninety one, forgets the tag pose and the counts.
Update runs every loop. Line one oh four loops over the cameras; we follow camera zero.
Line one oh five grabs its newest frame, one photo. Lines one oh six to one oh nine skip a frame number we've already seen.
Line one eleven calls find tag, at line one ninety seven, which looks through every tag in the photo for ours.
Line one fifteen gets the tag's 3D pose in robot space. Line one sixteen takes its floor distance: two point zero zero two five meters.
Line one seventeen skips the photo if that distance is almost zero, meaning no 3D answer, or beyond three point five meters.
